reciprocity_variations.note: Historical embassy fee for US citizens was $185 (higher due to reciprocity with US visa fees for Uzbek citizens). NOTE: Uzbekistan announced a visa abolition for US citizens for tourist visits up to 30 days, effective 1 January 2026 - US travellers should now be visa-free for short tourist stays; this reciprocity fee entry is retained for historical/edge-case reference only and should be re-verified.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates visa application centres for Uzbekistan for several countries (e.g. Ireland, Czech Republic, Hungary, UK, Finland application pages seen). Published service fee example: EUR 20 inclusive of VAT per application for Ireland-processed applications; fee varies by centre/country (Czech Republic example cites EUR 17). Not all Uzbekistan visa routes use VFS - e-visa applicants apply directly via e-visa.gov.uz.

free_visa_notes: Uzbekistan operates a broad visa-free regime for roughly 90 countries (durations 10-90+ days depending on nationality/bilateral agreement, commonly 30 days for USA/UK/EU/Japan/Australia/South Korea/GCC). Effective 1 January 2026, Uzbekistan abolished visa requirements for US citizens for tourist stays up to 30 days per a November 2025 presidential order. Citizens of ~80+ other countries not covered by the visa-free list can use the e-visa system; the remainder require an embassy-issued sticker visa.
